mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may potentiate pioglitazone's insulin-sensitizing effects and increase hypoglycemia risk; MAOIs can also cause weight gain and fluid retention which counteracts pioglitazone's metabolic benefits.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely; counsel patient on hypoglycemia symptoms; consider alternative antidepressant if possible; adjust pioglitazone or antidiabetic dosing as needed based on glucose monitoring.
